## EcrecoverRatifierUtils.digestRatifierData() function

Builds the EcrecoverRatifier digest from one payload item's encoded ratifier data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function digestRatifierData(params: EcrecoverRatifierDataDigestParams): Hash;
```

**Returns:**

Hash

EIP-712 digest signed by the maker or authorized signer.

## Exceptions

`ChainIdMismatchError` when `params.chainId` does not match `offer.market.chainId`<!-- -->.

`InvalidTreeHeightError` when the proof height exceeds 20.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Observed EIP-155 chain id from the log or execution context.

- `params.offer`<!-- -->: Offer carried by the payload item.

- `params.ratifierData`<!-- -->: ABI-encoded Ecrecover ratifier data.

## Example


```ts
import { EcrecoverRatifierUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const digest = EcrecoverRatifierUtils.digestRatifierData({
  chainId: 8453n,
  offer,
  ratifierData,
});
console.log(digest);
```
